questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.stem: Considering context and state dependence, matched state recall is 70%; mismatched is 45%. How many percentage points is the state-match benefit?
questions.explanation: 70 minus 45 equals 25 percentage points. This is the state match benefit.

questions.stem: Considering serial position effect, first items recalled at 60%; last items at 75%. How many percentage points is the recency advantage?
questions.explanation: 75 minus 60 equals 15 percentage points. This is the recency advantage over primacy here.

questions.stem: Considering forgetting curve and decay, a list of 50 words; 10 recalled after one day. What percentage of the words were forgotten?
